sn45.179:1.1: “Bhikkhus, there are these five lower fetters.
sn45.179:1.3: Identity view, doubt, the distorted grasp of rules and vows, sensual desire, ill will.
sn45.179:1.4: These are the five lower fetters.
sn45.179:1.5: This Noble Eightfold Path is to be developed for direct knowledge of these five lower fetters, for the full understanding of them, for their utter destruction, for their abandoning.”
